name: NPT Sportswear
old_description: Whether you are looking for a specific item or just browsing for ideas, our site is your one-stop source.
about:
NPT Sportswear operates from Newport, Rhode Island, where it was established in 2022. The company provides customized apparel and promotional products to organizations across the United States.

The firm sources and delivers a wide range of promotional items, including branded apparel, drinkware, bags, and event-specific giveaways. Its catalog spans categories such as golf accessories, wine and bar tools, made-in-USA products, and health-related items. NPT Sportswear emphasizes tailored product selection to maximize clients' return on investment and promotes competitive pricing across its offerings. The business runs on the ASI network, a common platform for promotional product distributors.

Clients range from corporations and educational institutions to healthcare providers, hospitality venues, sports leagues, non-profits, and government agencies. The company highlights use cases such as charity golf tournaments, employee recognition programs, school fundraisers, political campaigns, and bar or restaurant openings. Seasonal campaigns tie into events like the 2026 World Cup and the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, with a focus on domestically manufactured giveaways.

NPT Sportswear positions itself on efficient sourcing and value-driven customization, stating that its experience with organizations of all sizes allows it to deliver the right items with efficiency and value. The company stresses competitive pricing and a consultative approach to help customers select products that make the best impression.
